images.filename: 2016 One World Observatory view southsoutheast towards Brooklyn and Manhattan Bridges.jpg
images.caption: A view of the Manhattan (top) and Brooklyn (bottom) Bridges from the One World Observatory at One World Trade Center, Manhattan, New York City. The tall building partly obscuring the approach to the Brooklyn Bridge is Frank Gehry's 8 Spruce Street, and the top of the Gothic Revival Woorth Building can be seen in the foreground on the left side.  Between them, in front of the Manhattan Bridge, is 375 Pearl Street, a 32-story telephone switching building.
images.alt: A view of the Manhattan (top) and Brooklyn (bottom) Bridges from the One World Observatory at One World Trade Center, Manhattan, New York City. The tall building partly obscuring the approach to the Brooklyn Bridge is Frank Gehry's 8 Spruce Street, and the top of the Gothic Revival Woorth Building can be seen in the foreground on the left side.  Between them, in front of the Manhattan Bridge, is 375 Pearl Street, a 32-story telephone switching building.
